### PDU41002 error response shapes, over SERIAL
### firmware 1.3.4 / captured 2026-08-24
###
### THREE distinct shapes, not the two the manual documents. A parser that
### assumes "always a caret line" mis-handles the second one entirely.
###
### Note the caret line is introduced by a bare "\n\r", not "\r\n".

### SHAPE 1 — unknown verb: caret + "Command not found" + FULL VERB DUMP
### The verb dump is ~30 lines and is part of the error response. A read-until
### that stops at the first blank line will truncate mid-error and desync the
### session. This dump is also the authoritative verb list for firmware 1.3.4.
### CMD: bogusverb
bogusverb
             ^
Error : Command not found

    devsta
    devcfg
    oltsta
    oltcfg
    oltctrl
    schedule
    date
    ntp
    sys
    dst
    login
    admin
    device
    oltuser
    radius
    ldap
    tcpip
    tcpip6
    snmpv1
    snmpv3
    trap
    web
    console
    ftp
    eventlog
    syslog
    menumode
    clear
    exit

CyberPower >

### SHAPE 2 — out-of-range index: NO caret, NO "Error :" prefix
### Completely different shape from shapes 1 and 3. This is also the device's
### own statement that it has 8 outlets, and the check that confirms
### outlet_count without trusting the datasheet.
### CMD: oltsta index 99 show
oltsta index 99 show

Index number must be 1 to 8


CyberPower >

### SHAPE 3 — bad parameter: caret + "Parameter Error" + USAGE LINE
### The caret column (33) points at the offending token, and the usage line
### that follows is the authoritative argument list for oltctrl. Note there is
### no blank line before the prompt here, unlike shapes 1 and 2.
### CMD: oltctrl index 8 act bogus
oltctrl index 8 act bogus
                                 ^
Error : Parameter Error
    oltctrl index <outlet index> act <on | off| reboot| delayon| delayoff| delayreboot| cancel>
CyberPower >

### Parsing consequences
###
### 1. Detect errors by the presence of "Error :" OR the index-range sentence.
###    Keying only on "^" misses shape 2; keying only on "Error :" misses it too.
### 2. Capture the caret COLUMN when present (shapes 1 and 3) — that is the
###    CommandError.marker the driver reports.
### 3. Blank-line counts before the prompt differ per shape (2, 3, 0). Read
###    until the prompt, never until a blank line.
### 4. The oltctrl usage line above shows the exact accepted actions; note it
###    includes "reboot" and the "delay*" variants, and note the irregular
###    spacing ("on | off|") — do not generate commands from this string.
